title: Design Spells catalogue
description: Machine-readable contract for the design-spells catalogue. Generated by scripts/build.py alongside public/spells.json. AI agents and editors should treat this as the authoritative shape of every spell.

$schema.description: Points back at this schema document; present in public/spells.json.

total.description: Total number of spells in the catalogue.

id.description: Stable identifier, e.g. "ds-43". Refer to spells by this value.

section.description: Top-level section the spell lives under in the source document.

category.description: Normalised functional category used for filtering (e.g. Interaction, Scroll, Overlays).

rawCategory.description: Category as authored in the source document.

jsNeed.description: "none" = zero JS; "markup" = zero JS but requires a specific native HTML pattern.

html.description: Required markup (may be empty for CSS-only spells).

previewHtml.description: Self-contained markup used by the live preview.

previewCss.description: Preview CSS with :root/html/body rewritten to :host for the shadow-DOM sandbox.

feature.description: Human-readable summary of the CSS features the spell depends on.

supportNote.description: Detailed browser-support note, including version numbers where relevant.
